change_summary: Ran a runtime-only monkeypatch of `signal_engine.generate_signals()` and `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` against the deterministic late / mid / old OHLCV snapshots. Each candidate day received a broad stress flag computed from replayable whole-universe and index-state proxies already available in the repo: `breadth_above_200 <= 0.55`, `breadth_positive_mom <= 0.40`, `spy_pct_from_ma <= -3%`, `qqq_pct_from_ma <= -4%`, or a large `QQQ-SPY` momentum gap combined with weak short-horizon breadth. Screened two deployment shapes: gross risk haircut (`0.5x`, `0.25x`) and breakout-only haircut (`0.25x`, `0.0x`). No repository trading logic was kept after measurement.
component: runtime-only monkeypatch of `quant/signal_engine.py` + `quant/portfolio_engine.py` sizing path (rolled back; no repo trading logic changed)

delta_metrics.note: The branch failed because the broad stress-state overfired in the dominant recent tape. The gross-risk variants slightly helped only the middle window while still damaging both the late strong and old weak windows. The breakout-only variants simply cut useful convexity in the late strong window while behaving as nulls elsewhere. The trigger audit makes the failure mechanism explicit: this first stress-state definition marked roughly half of the late-strong window as stressed, so it is too broad to serve as the first live risk-state gate.

hypothesis: If the new meta-layer should start with a narrow `risk-state` branch, then a broad stress-state defined from replayable structure + pressure proxies should improve the accepted deterministic A+B stack by reducing risk when the tape is clearly stressed. A valid first pass should preserve or improve the dominant late-strong window while helping at least one weaker window.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: recent strong tape with breakout sleeve dominance

next_retry_requires: Do not retry the same OR-combined broad stress-state with nearby multipliers by default

If the risk-state branch continues, the next state definition must be materially narrower or hierarchical: for example require simultaneous breadth weakness + negative index pressure, not any single stress symptom
Keep `risk-state` and `healthy-tape sleeve routing` separate; this experiment only falsified the first broad stress template, not the whole meta-layer direction
notes: This stayed a single-causal-variable runtime-only experiment: only the sizing response changed when the broad stress-state fired. Entries, exits, ranking, and accepted cohort rules remained unchanged. The valuable result is structural: the first risk-state gate should be narrower and more hierarchical than this broad OR-combination.
rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability and bad trigger specificity. The broad stress-state definition confuses volatile-but-healthy breakout conditions with genuine weak-tape stress, so it overfires in the dominant recent window and destroys too much good convexity.
